{{Top|leg}}
The '''Starport Registry''' was located at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Meirm City]]. The interior was decorated in red [[Marble/Legends|marble]], and was one of the few buildings in the city to feature specially treated [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] windows. The Registry held records of all the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] arriving and departing Meirm City. The Registry was run by a [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Clerk/Legends|clerk]] and security was provided by a number of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
